name: Animated Counter
author: Mahbubur Rahman

sections.description:
Animated Counter is a lightweight and easy-to-use WordPress plugin that allows you to animate numbers directly within the Gutenberg editor toolbar. This plugin adds a custom format to the block editor toolbar, enabling you to highlight any number in your content and transform it into a smooth, animated counter on the frontend.

How It Works:

  1. Select any number inside a Gutenberg block.
  2. Click the Animated Counter button in the block editor toolbar.
  3. The number will be wrapped with a special format.
  4. On the frontend, the number will smoothly animate from 0 to its original value.

Video Guidelines

Give your content a dynamic touch and enhance user engagement effortlessly!

FEATURES

Seamless Integration: Works directly within the Gutenberg block editor.
One-Click Formatting: Select any number and apply the animation format from the toolbar.
Smooth Animations: Automatically animates numbers when they appear on the page.
No Coding Required: Easily animate numbers without writing a single line of code.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  3. In the Search Plugins box, type “Animated Counter”.
  4. Click “Install Now” on the Animated Counter plugin.
  5. Once installed, click Activate to enable the plugin.
